skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize traditional data presentation methods and basic statistical concepts such as population, sample, parameter, statistic, variable, observation, types of variables, and their meanings.
Classify variables and select appropriate tables and graphs to describe and identify key characteristics of data.
Calculate basic statistics including mean, median, variance, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, skewness, kurtosis, covariance, and correlation coefficient.
Differentiate the shapes of data distributions in real-world scenarios to draw conclusions about economic and business variables and their relationships.
Classify events, random variables, probability distributions, and properties of one-dimensional and two-dimensional random variables.
Represent complex events as sums or products of other events and calculate their probabilities.
Determine the probability distribution of a random variable and calculate its characteristic parameters.
Compare and choose based on probability and characteristic parameters of random variables to support decision-making in investment, management, production, and business.

Recognize the meaning of statistics, point estimation, estimation function, unbiased estimation, efficient estimation, confidence interval, statistical hypothesis, types of errors, test statistic, rejection region, and p-value.
Calculate probabilities and infer about sample statistics using the distribution of certain sample statistics.
Select appropriate confidence interval formulas based on requirements, calculate the length of the confidence interval, and find specific confidence intervals for parameters.
Describe the steps to test statistical hypotheses using rejection regions or p-values.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Decision Support Using Estimation and Testing
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Support decision-making in economic and business situations based on conclusions from estimation and testing.
Use software to create charts, calculate descriptive statistics, compare two parameters, and perform ANOVA on data from real-world scenarios.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Report Writing Based on Statistical Conclusions
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Write reports based on statistical conclusions to support decision-making in economics, management, administration, and business.
Develop self-learning abilities, work independently, and collaborate in teams.
Develop personal responsibility and partial responsibility towards the team.
